## 2.1.0

### Line-precise citations with click-to-jump

- Answers now cite sources as `[n:L<line>]` (e.g. `[36:L2418]`). Clicking a citation opens the note and jumps to the exact clause — one anchor per claim instead of one per note.
- Works in both reading and editing view (reading view uses eState plus text-anchored scrolling after async render).
- Three-tier line resolution: model-annotated line numbers, sentence-to-evidence alignment fallback, and a per-note registry anchor (reads outrank grep hits; whole-file reads of long notes no longer anchor at the TOC).
- Citation markers render compactly as `[n]`; ranges like `[n:L2418-L2419]` are supported.

### Agentic retrieval quality

- Progress-aware tool budget: turns that keep reading fresh evidence get an extended budget (up to 40 rounds), idle turns are closed after 3 rounds without new information, and a context watermark force-closes before requests can overflow.
- Gap-admission bounce: a draft answer that admits unread evidence (located but never read) is rejected once, tools are restored, and the model must read the region it named.
- grep zero-match results now explain formatting pitfalls (OCR inserts spaces inside phrases) and suggest broader retries; grep hits register their first matching line as the jump anchor.

### Retrieval path exclusion

- `search` / `keyword` / `semantic` / `ls` / `grep` / `find` accept an `exclude` parameter (path prefixes dropped from results), and the global excluded-paths setting is enforced at runtime — previously indexed content is filtered before scoring, and changing the rules purges matching content from the index automatically.

### UI & settings

- Reindex moved out of the collapsed Advanced section; it now sits right below Excluded paths.
- The Share tab and panel title are translated in all 11 locales; the Excluded paths button reads "Configure".
- The built-in `semlink-debug` MCP server now defaults to OFF and lives inside the MCP tab's Advanced section.
- The status-bar index card shows the indexed file count correctly right after startup.

### Developer

- New `semlink-debug` tools for end-to-end verification: `ask` returns the full thinking trace with citation anchors, `jump` opens a note at a line and reports the resulting scroll position.
